title: Curvature-Based Bounds for $p$-Capacity and Capacity--Area Inequalities
summary: We establish curvature-based bounds for the $p$-capacity of convex domains and related capacity--area inequalities. Let $K$ denote the Gauss--Kronecker curvature of $\partialΩ$. In Euclidean space, if $ 0<K_-\leq K\leq K_+, $ then, for every $1<p\leq \frac{n+1}{2}$, $$ \operatorname{Cap}_p\left(B(K_+^{\frac{1}{1-n}})\right) \leq \operatorname{Cap}_p(Ω) \leq \operatorname{Cap}_p\left(B(K_-^{\frac{1}{1-n}})\right). $$ The lower comparison remains valid for the full range $1<p<n$.
